title: Normalization of a parity block assignment
statement: Given natural numbers $n$, $r$, and $g$, and a function $a$ assigning a sign to each index $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, define a new assignment whose value at $j$ is $a(j)$ if $gr+j<n$, and is $1$ otherwise.
